cards.name: Footwork
cards.text: You may move 1 space left or right. Draw 1 card.

cards.name: Cull
cards.text: Trash 1 or 2 cards. Choose Cull itself, cards remaining in your hand, or both.

cards.name: Feint
cards.text: At Close range, the next Close-range attack this turn deals 2 additional damage.

cards.name: Drive
cards.text: At Close range, deal 2 damage. Then move both fighters 1 space left or right so they remain Close. If a wall blocks the move, neither fighter moves, and the attack deals 2 additional damage.

cards.name: Flurry
cards.text: Deal 1 damage for each other Action played this turn, to a maximum of 5.

cards.name: Aim
cards.text: At Near or Far range, become Aimed, then draw one card.

cards.name: Volley
cards.text: Deal 2 damage at Near range or 5 damage at Far range. Aimed changes this to 5 or 7.
